basics.name: Taha Ali
basics.label: Associate Professor · Engineer · Researcher · Writer
basics.summary: Academic, researcher, consultant, and election technology practitioner working at the intersection of computer networks, information security, emerging technologies, technology policy, and society.

work.name: National University of Sciences and Technology
work.location: NUST School of Electrical Engineering and Computer Science (SEECS), Islamabad
work.summary: I teach at NUST-SEECS and head the Cognet Lab, researching security applications in new and emerging technologies including blockchain, machine learning, computer vision, and Internet of Things.
highlights: Teach computer programming, computer networks, network security, cryptocurrencies and blockchain.
Head the Cognet Lab.
Supervised 25 Masters students and 2 PhD students to graduation.
Introduced a Masters-level course on Cryptocurrencies and Blockchain technology at NUST in 2018.

work.name: National University of Sciences and Technology
work.location: NUST School of Electrical Engineering and Computer Science (SEECS), Islamabad
highlights: Taught at NUST-SEECS.
Taught computer programming, computer networks, network security, and cryptocurrencies.
Headed the Cognet Lab.

work.name: Newcastle University
highlights: Worked on a flagship EU project on secure and verifiable electronic voting systems.
Contributed to projects on cryptocurrencies and blockchain.
Initiated a project on next-generation botnets.
Contributed to Real-World Electronic Voting: Design, Analysis and Deployment.

work.name: University of New South Wales
highlights: Worked on security and green applications of software-defined networks.
Worked on data provenance mechanisms for healthcare and IoT devices.

work.name: CSIRO
highlights: Worked on greening residential WiFi networks.
Developed algorithms to strategically adjust the mode and transmit power of WiFi access points in response to user traffic.
Achieved power savings of up to 40% in the project.

work.name: WorldCALL Broadband, Pvt. Ltd. (WBL)
highlights: Took on engineering and management roles in deploying Pakistan's largest hybrid-fiber-coax broadband network.

education.thesis: Security Mechanisms for Body Sensor Networks
highlights: Supervisors: Vijay Sivaraman and Diethelm Ostry.
Research focused on security requirements in bodyworn health monitoring devices, including secure broadcast, data confidentiality, data authentication and provenance.

education.institution: GIK Institute of Engineering Sciences & Technology
courses: Final Year Project: Software Control for Embedded Systems using Jini

projects.name: Coding Fellows Program
projects.summary: A STEM education initiative training teachers to deliver coding, AI, IT, and information security education in government schools in Islamabad.
highlights: Developing and curating lesson plans.
Organizing STEM competitions and tournaments.
Organizing introductory university visits for students.

projects.name: High Impact Skills Development Program in AI, Data Science, and Blockchain
projects.summary: A flagship collaboration between the Gilgit Baltistan government and NUST focused on developing the skills of youth in Gilgit Baltistan.
highlights: Curating and teaching a six-month specialized blockchain technology course.
Topics include cryptocurrencies, smart contracts, Solidity, decentralized applications, security and policy.

projects.name: Electronic Voting Machines for Pakistan
projects.summary: Policy research project examining opportunities, challenges and a roadmap for electronic voting in Pakistan.
highlights: Served as Co-PI.
Project funded by the Pakistan Institute of Development Economics through its RASTA grants program.

projects.name: PIVOT — Promoting Innovative Voting Technologies
projects.summary: NUST research initiative promoting responsible use of election technology.
highlights: Technical talks, newspaper articles, social media and a dedicated newsletter.
Undertook a study on the dynamics of overseas voting in Pakistan.
Served on the committee responsible for devising policy on electronic voting and assessing different electronic voting machines.

volunteer.organization: Ministry of IT & Telecommunications / Ministry of Science and Technology
highlights: Served on various committees concerning technology policy.
Co-curated a regional conference on Rights, Access, and Technology in Elections.
Delivered a talk titled How a State Examines Technology on Pakistan's election technology experience.
